findings.message:
Repository URL is https://github.com/NamcheAI/namche-fonts. But:

* HTML description has 'href="https://github.com/fizzybubbele">Michael'
* HTML description has 'href="https://github.com/NamcheAI/namche-fonts">the'
Please remove 'cyrillic-ext' from METADATA.pb since less than 20% of its glyphs are supported by this font file.
Please remove 'latin-ext' from METADATA.pb since less than 20% of its glyphs are supported by this font file.

The font has the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text for language Aleut, but although the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets cyrillic, cyrillic-ext, latin, latin-ext, vietnamese:

* ̂ (U+0302)

We detected support for the Amarakaeri language because the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, but the font is missing the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text (This suggests there's something wrong with the sample text):

* ̱ (U+0331)

We detected support for the Otomi, Mezquital language because the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, but the font is missing the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text (This suggests there's something wrong with the sample text):

* ̱ (U+0331)

We detected support for the Secoya language because the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, but the font is missing the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text (This suggests there's something wrong with the sample text):

* ̱ (U+0331)
